name: SNTL Real-time, live, Helium and Geo-spatial Intelligence 1M records (1 Year History)
display_name: SNTL: DePIN Spatial Intelligence & x402 rail to SQL DataLake
description: Pay-per-query intelligence for the Helium, Solana, and DePIN. Query an AI-classified datalake of enriched on-chain events across 12 program shards: threat tiers (critical->low), anomaly scores, H3 geospatial hotspot resolution, forensic space-time-power chronicles, tiered LLM escalation verdicts, and scored wallet/audience segments. 26 machine skills plus sandboxed SQL SELECT (SELECT-only, LIMIT<=100, allow-listed tables). $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Solana mainnet - no signup, no API key. Two skills are free: probe before you pay. Built for autonomous agents that need to check a Solana/Helium wallet, tx, or program and get back a classified, on-chain-verifiable answer. The protocol is the UI. https://pop-os.tail08831d.ts.net

extensions.description: Pay-per-call via x402 - $0.01 USDC on Solana mainnet, gasless via PayAI facilitator. No signup, no API key, no CDP.

params.proof_note: Live-rail agent-to-agent settlement, verifiable on Solana mainnet.

x402.description: Per-query settlement. Server returns 402 with accepts:[PaymentRequirements]; client resubmits with X-PAYMENT header. Solana mainnet USDC, gasless via PayAI facilitator. $0.01 per paid call. Free skills require no payment.

x-free-tier.description: Two skills are free. Probe these to verify the rail before spending.

x-limits.note: Paid calls are $0.01. Page with limit rather than requesting large result sets.
